steps: Create a second GDScript through the built-in script starter, edit its ordinary TXT draft and Save; only its source and registration are added.

A saved Scene2D without any behavior opens first-behavior creation. Three bindings share two scene instances and two scripts; stable identities survive selection and full source and all four deduplicated relationships are reviewed, then Cancel writes nothing. Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px preserve fields and review, keep Return/Review/Save visible, and allow body scrolling without horizontal overflow.

One reviewed transaction creates exactly the manifest and its registration and appends the scene behavior relationship, retaining the scene metadata CRLF. Scene/script/asset source bytes are unchanged. The explicit Open button enters the real source editor and exposes the existing behavior editor.

The independent behavior editor configures separate text/number parameters and signal aliases for all three stable bindings across two scripts. Apply only changes the draft; ordinary Save persists those exact reviewed bytes and changes no other author files.

The newly created and edited manifest drives real Godot plan → build → headless run: two scripts across three stable bindings emit all three independently configured events on their declared instances, including two bindings on one instance.

The resulting generated project is inspected, delivered through a real browser download, independently verified and extracted, then imported by real Godot at a new location. Scripts and image resources are present; no further author writes occur.
